slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第一章这年头，大家都想成为武者【新书求收藏】
天空之上大日悬挂，即使已经接近十月中旬，但空气依旧灼热，仿佛依然是在夏天一般。
來峻市第三高中，高三4班教室里，相貌平平，又寻常普通的王璃坐在自己的位置上，双手拿着略显崭新的课本，目光视线注视着前方。
教室讲台上，一个略微有些瘦，但个子很高的男人正在讲解着各种知识要点，不时间还在黑板上写写画画，讲到酣处，更是手舞足蹈，嘎嘎直叫。
至于王璃……他在发呆。
他的目光虽然在注视前方，虽然在教室里，但却正以一种非常熟练自然的姿势走着神。
“十八年了……不知不觉来这个世界已经整整十八年了啊，这小日子过的，真是嗖嗖的啊……”
“不过这样的日子其实也不错！”
“不但多活了十八年，还返老还童了，这一波啊，简直就是秦始皇吃着花椒啃电线——赢得麻上加麻！”
是的，今年刚刚十八岁的王璃，有一個非常小的小秘密……
他是一个穿越者！
或者说，与其说王璃是一个穿越者，不如说他是一个携带着前世记忆，又被胎中之迷迷蒙了十八年，这一刻才完美融合了两世记忆的“轮回者”
而且相比起前世，事实上王璃更加喜欢今生的世界。
不，更准确的说，从自己记忆觉醒以后，王璃就不曾对前世有过什么所谓的“眷顾”
的感情。
更加没有前世那一本本网络小说里，那些穿越了异世界，或者说什么世界的主角们，那种撕心裂肺，鬼哭狼嚎，不择手段，想尽一切办法试图回归原世界，仿佛不回元世界，自己下一刻就要死的想法。
“真是开玩笑哩！
我王璃看着像是那种人吗？”
王璃同学呲笑不止，就差没有当场笑出猪叫声。
前世的王璃不过是一个在孤儿院里长大，对整个社会而言根本无足轻重，二十好几了，还是“微小螺丝钉”

，甚至连猝死以后，都绝对好几天都没人知道在意的那种。
而在这个世界里，王璃却是一个有有父有母，有弟有妹，还有青梅……咳咳咳的十八岁少年郎。
嘎嘎嘎，说说看，什么叫做人生赢家啊——战术后仰！
这一比较，王璃能对前世有归属感，那才是真有大问题呢！
“更何况……这个世界里……可是还有超凡啊～～～”
课堂下面，王璃悄悄伸出左手手掌，放在自己眼前反复打量。
那是一只温润如玉，莹莹剔透的手掌。
有一说一，就这样的皮肤，如果是在前世，没有十几，几十万，甚至上百万的金钱往里填，没有最专业，最顶尖的医疗团队几年如一日的时间慢工细磨，那里可能有这样的皮肤特效？
但在这世界里，这不过是一个将大汉联邦三十二套基础内功之一的《混元气功》练到武徒三层以后，自然而然的会出现外在表现而已。
武者，这个世界所有的超凡职业者。
通过修炼武道秘籍，吸纳大气之中游离的种种元气粒子，锤炼肉体精神，使得肉身逐渐“不坏”
，精神逐渐“不朽”

Chapter 1: These days, everyone wants to be a warrior [New book for collection]
The sun hung high in the sky, and even though it was almost mid-October, the air was still hot, as if it was still summer.
In the classroom of Class 4, Grade 3, Laijun City No. 3 High School, the plain-looking and ordinary Wang Li sat in his seat, holding a slightly brand-new textbook in his hands and looking forward.
On the classroom platform, a slightly thin but tall man was explaining various knowledge points. He also wrote and drew on the blackboard from time to time. When he was talking, he danced and screamed.
As for Wang Li... he was in a daze.
Although his eyes were looking forward, even though he was in the classroom, he was walking in a very skillful and natural posture.
"It's been eighteen years... It's been eighteen years since I came to this world before I knew it. It's been such a blast..."
"But days like this are actually not bad!"
"Not only did he live for eighteen more years, but he also regained his youth. This time, it's like Qin Shihuang eating peppercorns and chewing wires - winning more!"
Yes, Wang Li, who just turned eighteen this year, has a very small secret...
He is a time traveler!
In other words, rather than saying that Wang Li is a time traveler, it is better to say that he is a "reincarnation" who carries the memory of his previous life and was confused by the mystery in the womb for eighteen years. At this moment, he perfectly merged the memories of the two lives.
And compared to his previous life, Wang Li actually liked this world more.
No, to be more precise, Wang Li has never had any so-called "favor" for his past life since he awakened his memory.
feelings.
There is no such thing as the protagonists in the online novels in their previous lives who traveled to another world, or some other world, who were heart-wrenching, crying like ghosts, howling like ghosts, trying every means to return to the original world, as if they would die the next moment if they didn't return to the original world.
"What a joke!
Do I, Wang Li, look like that kind of person? "
Classmate Wang Li couldn't stop laughing, almost laughing like a pig on the spot.
In the previous life, Wang Li was just a kid who grew up in an orphanage and was of no importance to the entire society. He was still a "tiny screw" in his twenties.
, even after a sudden death, no one knows or cares about it for several days.
But in this world, Wang Li is an eighteen-year-old boy who has a father, a mother, a younger brother, a younger sister, and a green plum...ahem.
Quack, tell me, what does it mean to be a winner in life - tactical retreat!
In this comparison, if Wang Li can have a sense of belonging in his previous life, then that's really a big problem!
"What's more... in this world... there are still extraordinary ones~~~"
Below the classroom, Wang Li quietly stretched out the palm of his left hand and placed it in front of his eyes to look at it repeatedly.
It was a palm as gentle as jade, crystal clear.
One thing to say is that if skin like this was in a previous life, without tens, hundreds of thousands, or even millions of money being spent on it, and without the most professional and top-notch medical team working slowly and meticulously for several years, how could there be such special skin effects?
But in this world, this is just a matter of practicing "Hunyuan Qigong", one of the thirty-two basic internal skills of the Han Federation, to the third level of martial arts, and the external manifestations will naturally appear.
Warriors, all extraordinary professionals in this world.
By practicing martial arts secrets, absorbing various vitality particles floating in the atmosphere, tempering the body and spirit, making the body gradually "indestructible"
, the spirit gradually becomes "immortal"
